title: Terminal plugin test interview prints a command instead of running the tests
body:
Found while OpenAgents created the disk-cleanup plugin through its own flow (#10165, thread 06904082b508c7130af68f9a00386d37 on the Mac; doc docs/background/2026-10-02-disk-cleanup-plugin.md).

In OpenAgents Terminal, the plugin test interview (`openagents plugin test init` path) ends by printing the command to run the tests instead of running them. It should run them in place (streaming progress) and show the result, and offer to publish.
